name: osf-sustainer-form
description: Lambda handler that emails sustainer applications from osf.it.uic.edu

scripts.package: rm -rf build function.zip && mkdir -p build && cp index.mjs package.json build/ && npm install --omit=dev --prefix build && cd build && zip -qr ../function.zip . && cd .. && rm -rf build
scripts.deploy: npm run package && aws lambda update-function-code --region us-east-2 --function-name osf-sustainer-form --zip-file fileb://function.zip --no-cli-pager
